text:
Maya R: quick heads-up — spotted two broken anchors in the KB article `platform/runtime-deployments.md` (section 'canary-rollouts' and one inline image link)
Lee T: thanks, can you paste the broken urls/snippets? i can take the canary anchor
Maya R: sure — anchor currently in file is `#canary-deploys` but the heading is `## Canary rollouts` so link uses `#canary-rollouts` elsewhere. looks like one commit renamed the heading but not the anchor reference.
Maya R: image: `![architecture diagram](https://cdn.internal/redwood/runbook/arch-v2.png)` returns 403 in staging — likely a CDN path mismatch
Alex P: @Lee T if you have a sec, i can open the tiny PR for the anchor fix. grep pattern i used:
Alex P: ```
grep -n "canary" -R docs/
sed -n '1,200p' docs/platform/runtime-deployments.md | sed -n '1,120p'
```
docs-bot: automated link-scan alert: docs/platform/runtime-deployments.md -> 1 failed image fetch (403) detected at 1769912300
Jamie: i can re-upload the diagram to the CDN and create a new path that has public read, but need owner for that doc to approve the replace
Maya R: who is listed as owner? frontmatter shows `owner: eng-platform` which is a team alias — need an individual to cc
Lee T: tagging @Alex P for review + will cc @Sara L for the CDN upload approval — Sara owns CDN keys
Sara L: got it, will re-upload after Alex's PR lands. 
Alex P: i'll open a 1-line PR to change the anchor reference from `#canary-deploys` -> `#canary-rollouts` and add a quick comment about the rename. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3287
Alex P: PR includes this patch:
Alex P: ```diff
-See more at [Canary deploys](#canary-deploys)
+See more at [Canary rollouts](#canary-rollouts)
```
Lee T: reviewed and approved in the PR, left a :thumbsup:
Alex P: landed and merged (main) — sha: d9f3b2a
Sara L: uploaded diagram to `https://cdn.internal/redwood/runtime/arch-v2.png` and set acl=public-read. replaced image link in the doc and pushed small PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3288
Maya R: thanks team — verified both staging preview and the internal link checker show green now :tada:
Jamie: can we add `eng-platform` to the doc frontmatter as a fallback contact (owner: eng-platform, owner-person: Lee T) so future pings are clearer?
Lee T: yeah i'll open a follow-up to add `owner-person: Lee T` and a tiny note in the contributor guide about anchor renames
Maya R: perfect. leaving this thread open for any post-deploy regressions but appears resolved. closing in 24h if no issues.
__notes: Follow-up: keep this short thread style; all messages are chronological and representative of an internal docs coordination workflow. No title field included per agents.md rules.
